common.staleShown: The latest data did not load. You are seeing the last saved copy.

home.checkedIn: Checked in. Please wait to be called.
home.previsitProgress: Your previsit is half done. You can pick it up.
home.previsitSent: Previsit sent. The doctor reads it before seeing you.
home.previsitTodo: No previsit yet. Finish it first and the doctor will have read it.
home.noNextBody: Pick a time when you need a visit or a renewal.
home.medsNoneBody: Prescriptions from the clinic appear here with the date of the next refill.
home.emptyNote: The people and data here are fictional.

advice.open: There is already a request in progress for this medicine.
advice.openDraft: You started a request for this medicine and have not sent it.
advice.windowOpen: You can book this refill now. Collect it by {{to}}.
advice.late: The refill window has passed, but the check still allows a booking. Collect it soon.
advice.lateBlocked: The refill window has passed and this prescription can no longer be refilled. Book a visit.
advice.soon: You can book the refill from {{from}}.
advice.onHand: Your supply lasts to {{supply}}. The next refill opens on {{from}}.
advice.renew: All refills are used. You can ask for a renewal. Your supply lasts to {{supply}}.
advice.renewIndividual: All refills are used. A doctor has to assess this medicine individually; you can send a request. Supply to {{supply}}.
advice.noFillsLeft: No refills are left on this prescription.
advice.excluded: This medicine cannot be requested online. Book a visit. Supply to {{supply}}.
advice.preview: The check suggests a visit first.
advice.self: You added this medicine yourself. It cannot be refilled or renewed here.

visits.title: Previsits
visits.lede: Tell us what is going on before you see the doctor. Every conversation is kept and can be resumed.
visits.noneBody: Before your appointment, take a few minutes to describe your symptoms and questions. The doctor reads them first.
visits.noneArchivedBody: Archived previsits are kept here. Nothing is deleted.

visitNew.title: Start a previsit
visitNew.lede: The assistant asks one thing at a time and puts your answers in order for the doctor.
visitNew.noApptHint: You can book later. The care team sees it once you send it.
visitNew.apptsFailed: Your appointments did not load. You can start without linking one.
visitNew.time: About ten questions, depending on your situation. Stop any time and continue on another device.
visitNew.asks: What is wrong, when it started, how it changed, history, medicines and allergies. What your record already has only needs a yes.
visitNew.result: A summary you can edit field by field, plus your questions for the doctor.
visitNew.after: The doctor reads it before your visit. After review you will see the doctor’s message here.
visitNew.disc1: You are talking to an AI. It organises what you say. It does not diagnose, prescribe or suggest doses.
visitNew.disc2: What you write is processed by an AI model in the cloud. Phone and ID numbers are masked first.
visitNew.disc3: Clinic staff can read it. Every read is recorded and listed under Privacy and data.
visitNew.disc4: Not for emergencies. For chest pain, trouble breathing or fainting, call 119.
visitNew.agree: I understand and agree to a previsit with AI
visitNew.existsTitle: This appointment already has a previsit
visitNew.existsOpen: It is not sent yet. You can continue.
visitNew.existsSent: It has been sent to the doctor.

visit.humanNow: You are talking with {{name}}. The AI is paused.
visit.fictional: Do not enter real medical or personal data
visit.closed: This previsit has been sent and is closed. To reach the care team, go to Messages.
visit.sentLine: Sent {{date}}. You will be told when the doctor has read it.
visit.doctorNoteEmpty: The doctor has reviewed it and left no message.
visit.redFlagStrip: What you described may be an emergency. Get help first; do not wait for a reply here.
visit.paused: This previsit is paused and the AI will not ask more. Once you are safe or have been seen, you can send what is here or ask the care team to contact you.
visit.sendAnyway: Send what is here to the doctor
visit.ticketLine: Passed to the care team, ticket {{no}}
visit.draftTitle: A request draft was created and not sent
visit.draftBody: Open it to finish the remaining steps. A doctor or pharmacist handles it.
visit.budgetTitle: Today’s AI quota is used up
visit.aiOffBody: Red-flag checks still run. You can still write and send; the care team reads it directly.
visit.draftGone: Sent or discarded on another device

field.hpi_modifiers: What makes it better or worse

sum.title: Previsit summary
sum.liveNote: Noted as you talk. If something is wrong, tap Correct and tell the assistant.
sum.readyNote: The summary is ready. You can edit every field.
sum.editedNote: Your edits go to the doctor as they are.
sum.sentNote: Sent {{date}}. It can no longer be changed.
sum.fromField: Go to what you said about {{field}}, {{n}}
sum.questionExample: For example: do I need a blood test?
sum.notCollected_one: {{count}} item was not covered; the doctor may ask.
sum.notCollected_other: {{count}} items were not covered; the doctor may ask.

review.title: Check before sending
review.lede: The doctor will see this. Fix anything that is wrong.
review.noSummaryBody: If you send now, your answers so far are put in order for the doctor. Go back to add more.
review.redFlag: This previsit contains an emergency sign
review.redFlagBody: Sending is not a call for help. If you still feel unwell, call 119 first.
review.notAskedBody: You do not have to add these. The doctor may ask during the visit.
review.next1: The care team reads it. You have no appointment yet; book one if you need a visit.
review.next1Appt: {{doctor}} reads it before your visit on {{date}}.
review.next2: You cannot change it after sending.
review.next3: You are notified after review, and the doctor’s message appears here.
review.unsent_one: {{count}} message has not been delivered. It sends when you are back online; then send the previsit.
review.unsent_other: {{count}} messages have not been delivered. They send when you are back online; then send the previsit.
review.running: The assistant is still working on your last answer.

summary.title: Previsit summary
summary.lede: This is what the doctor sees.
summary.noneBody: The assistant writes a summary once the conversation has covered the basics.
summary.notSent: Not sent to the doctor yet.

handoff.open: Ask the care team to contact me
handoff.title: Ask the care team to contact you
handoff.body: A coordinator or doctor replies in this conversation, not by phone, during clinic hours. In an emergency call 119.
handoff.again: This conversation already has a ticket. Sending again adds to it.
handoff.doneBody: Ticket {{no}}. You will be notified of a reply.

facts.lead: Your record has {{conditions}} conditions, {{medications}} medicines and {{allergies}} allergies. Confirm them instead of repeating.
facts.title: Is this still right?
facts.extraHint: Such as a new medicine or a recent reaction.

quick.label: Tap to fill in, then edit

trace.title_one: How this reply was made ({{count}} step)
trace.title_other: How this reply was made ({{count}} steps)
trace.titleRules_one: Handled by rules, no AI call ({{count}} step)
trace.titleRules_other: Handled by rules, no AI call ({{count}} steps)
trace.lead: Red-flag checks run first, then the AI replies, then the reply is checked.
trace.leadRules: The program answered by fixed rules with prepared text.

tool.scope_precheck: Check whether staff should handle it

meds.title: Medicines
meds.lede: Which refill you are on, how long the supply lasts and when the next one opens.
meds.noneBody: Prescriptions from the clinic appear here. For a new medicine, book a visit.
meds.ownBody: From other clinics, over the counter, supplements. Staff can see them; they cannot be refilled or renewed here.
meds.ownNameHint: As printed on the bag or package.

scope.title: Medicines for online renewal
scope.lede: The clinic sets the list and the program only sorts by it. Being listed does not mean approval; a doctor decides every request.
scope.in_scope: The program checks your answers, then a doctor decides.
scope.physician_only: You can send a request; a doctor assesses it individually and may ask you to visit.
scope.excluded: Controlled drugs, injections and others are not accepted online. Book a visit.
scope.noMatch: Not on the list. Medicines that are not listed cannot be requested online.

rx.title: My requests
rx.lede: Refill bookings and renewal requests, with their progress.
rx.noneBody: Start one from your medicines when a refill opens or a renewal is due.

rxNew.title: New request
rxNew.lede: Choose what you need, then the medicine. Everything is saved as you go.
rxNew.refillHint: Refills are left. Book the next collection; a pharmacist checks it.
rxNew.renewalHint: Refills are nearly or fully used. Your information goes to a doctor, who decides.
rxNew.noRefill: No refill can be booked now
rxNew.noRenewal: Nothing can be renewed online now
rxNew.noneBody: The reason is next to each medicine below.
rxNew.notPrescription: A request is not a prescription. A doctor reviews each one, and the prescription itself is written during a visit or remote consultation.

pharm.label: Pharmacy
pharm.hint: These pharmacies are fictional, for demonstration.

wizard.saveFailed: Your last change was not saved to the server
wizard.itemsLede: See the scope of each medicine and why.
wizard.excludedTitle: This one will not be sent
wizard.excludedBody: It is not accepted online. Book a visit.
wizard.identityTitle: Is this how you take it now?
wizard.identityLede: Shown as on the prescription record. Just say same or different; no doses needed.
wizard.sameQuestion: Are you taking {{drug}} as written above?
wizard.sameNoNote: That is fine. The doctor will see it and may ask you to visit. Please do not change how you take it on your own.
wizard.monLede: Fill in what you have and skip the rest. For old results the doctor decides whether to repeat the test.
wizard.monSkip: Leave it empty if you do not have it. The doctor will see that it is empty.
wizard.pharmTitle: Where do you want to collect?
wizard.pharmLede: The pharmacy is told after a doctor agrees.
wizard.pickupLede: A pharmacist checks and prepares it, then you are notified.
wizard.pickupSlotHint: Choose the date first. Check the pharmacy’s hours.
wizard.reviewLede: You can go back and change anything.
wizard.replyLede: Changed answers are sent with your reply.
wizard.checkBody: This only tells the doctor where to look. It is not approval or a diagnosis.
wizard.consent1: A doctor reviews every request. Nothing is approved automatically.
wizard.consent2: This is not a prescription. After agreeing, the doctor still writes it during a visit or remote consultation.
wizard.consent3: Doses and medicines cannot be changed here. If a change is needed you will be asked to visit.
wizard.consent4: Your answers are seen by the doctor and the pharmacy you chose, and every read is recorded.
wizard.consent5: The expected time is shown after sending. If you feel unwell while waiting, seek care.
wizard.consentR1: A pharmacist checks identity, allergies, interactions and quantity, and may return it or ask a doctor.
wizard.consentR2: Bring your NHI card and the original prescription.
wizard.consentR3: Your answers are seen by the pharmacy you chose, and every read is recorded.
wizard.agree: I have read this, my answers are true, and I agree to a doctor’s review
wizard.agreeRefill: I have read this and my answers are true
wizard.urgentBody: An answer points to an emergency. Call 119 now or have someone take you to the emergency room.
wizard.urgentChoice: Once you are safe you can alert the care team. If you chose by mistake, go back and change it.
wizard.urgentAlerted: The care team has been alerted. This request will not be handled as a routine one.
wizard.urgentNotSent: The alert was not sent. Call 119 directly
wizard.urgentStill: Your answers still point to an emergency
wizard.urgentStillBody: Change the answer you chose by mistake. If it was not a mistake, call 119.
wizard.conflictWaiting: Another device changed the same answers. Nothing is saved until you choose.

rxd.sentBody: A doctor reviews each item and you are notified. You can leave this page.
rxd.sentBodyRefill: The pharmacy checks and prepares it, then you are notified.
rxd.urgentBody: This request contains an emergency. If you still feel unwell call 119 now; do not wait.
rxd.overdueBody: This is past the expected time. Leave a message below; if you are running out, contact the clinic.
rxd.bring: Bring your NHI card. Someone collecting for you needs it too.
rxd.notPrescription: This is a request, not a prescription. A doctor writes the prescription.
rxd.approveNote: The doctor agreed to renew as before. The prescription itself is written during a visit or remote consultation.
rxd.replyHint: After you send it, it goes back to the doctor.
rxd.otherDraft: There is another draft on a different device
rxd.newMessageHint: The doctor and the pharmacy can read it. In an emergency call 119.
rxd.cancelBody: This cannot be undone. You would have to start again.

slip.title: Pickup slip
slip.bringValue: NHI card and the original prescription
slip.readyNote: Give this number at the counter. The pharmacist checks your identity first.
slip.waitNote: Not ready yet. Please wait for the notification before you go.

appt.title: Appointments
appt.lede: Finish your previsit before the visit.
appt.todayBody: Check in at the counter with your NHI card. You can still finish the previsit while you wait.
appt.todayVideo: Finish the previsit first and have a quiet place and your NHI card ready.
appt.cancelBody: The time is released to others. You would have to book again.
appt.cancelBodyVisit: The time is released to others. Your previsit is kept but no longer linked.
appt.bookedBody: You can do the previsit before the visit.
appt.keptOldTitle: New time booked, but the old one was not cancelled
appt.keptOldBody: Cancel the one you do not need below.

book.title: Book an appointment
book.lede: Choose a department or doctor, then a time. Up to four weeks ahead.
book.moveLede: Currently {{date}}, {{doctor}}. The old time is cancelled once you choose a new one.
book.noneBody: Try another week, department or doctor.
book.takenTitle: That time has just been taken
book.takenBody: The times have been updated. Choose another.
book.pickFirst: Pick a time and the booking button appears here.

msgs.title: Messages
msgs.lede: Conversations with the care team and messages on your requests.
msgs.noneBody: Conversations handed to a person, the doctor’s messages after review and messages on requests appear here.
msgs.notUrgent: Messages are answered during clinic hours. In an emergency call 119.
msgs.contactBody: Tell us what it is about. A coordinator or doctor replies here.
msgs.reason_patient_request: I want someone to contact me
msgs.reason_side_effects: I feel unwell after a medicine
msgs.noteHint: No real names, phone or ID numbers.
msgs.threadEmpty: No messages from the care team yet.
msgs.closedAi: The care team has not taken over or has handed back to the AI. To reach a person, use Contact the care team on Messages.
msgs.closedDone: This conversation is closed. For something new, use Contact the care team on Messages.

profile.title: Health record
profile.lede: Previsits and requests use this. Clinic entries are marked as clinic record, yours as self-reported.
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHint: A nickname, not your real name.
profile.allergies_none: Nothing on record. You can write “none”.
profile.removeBody: It is removed from your record and cannot be undone. To keep it, mark it as ended instead.
profile.clinicNote: To correct a clinic entry, tell the doctor at your visit.
profile.smokingHint: Such as never, stopped, half a pack a day.
profile.exerciseHint: Such as a half-hour walk a day.
profile.pharmacyBody: Listed first in requests. You can still choose another.

measure.title: Measurements
measure.lede: Keep your home readings here. Previsits and requests can use them.
measure.chartNote: Hollow marks are yours, solid ones the clinic’s. There is no reference line; the doctor judges the values.
measure.noneBody: Add readings and they become a trend.
measure.labNameHint: As on the report, such as HbA1c.
measure.future: The time cannot be in the future.
measure.notJudged: This only records. Nobody watches it live and values are not judged. If you feel unwell, do not wait.
measure.emergencyLink: What to do in an emergency

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.lede: What you agreed to, who has read your data, where you are signed in, and how to export or delete it.
privacy.guestBody: It is deleted after that. Set a username and password to keep it.
privacy.consentsBody: You can withdraw any time. What was already sent is not affected.
privacy.docBody_terms: A demonstration, not a medical service. Do not enter real personal data.
privacy.docBody_ai_disclosure: Your answers are processed by a cloud AI model. Phone and ID numbers are masked first.
privacy.docBody_rx_review: Requests go to a doctor and the pharmacy you choose. Nothing is approved automatically.
privacy.withdrawBody_terms: Please stop using the site after withdrawing. To remove your data, use Delete below.
privacy.withdrawBody_ai_disclosure: You will be asked again before the next previsit. Existing conversations are kept.
privacy.withdrawBody_rx_review: You will be asked again at the next request. Requests in progress continue.
privacy.accessBody: Every read by clinic staff is listed. Your own views are not.
privacy.accessNone: Nobody has read your data yet
privacy.devicesBody: If you do not recognise one, sign it out and change your password.
privacy.keepBody: Demo data and previsits are kept for at most {{days}} days.
privacy.exportBody: Download a JSON file with your record, previsits, requests and appointments.
privacy.deleteBody: Your account and all data are deleted at once, including requests in progress.
privacy.deleteWarn: This cannot be undone. Export first if you want a copy.
privacy.deleteSure: I understand this cannot be recovered

settings.title: Settings
settings.claimBody: Demo data is deleted on {{date}}. Set a username and password to keep it and sign in later.
settings.claimBodyPlain: Set a username and password to keep the data and sign in later.
settings.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Choose another.
settings.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Do not reuse a password.
settings.claimed: Account set up. Your data is kept
settings.follows: These follow your account to other devices.
settings.notifyBody: Notifications appear on this site only, for:
settings.notify_visit: A doctor’s review of a previsit, or a message from the care team
settings.notify_rx: Progress on a request, a question, or medicine ready
settings.notifyNone: No email and no text messages are sent.
settings.passwordForced: Change the password of this account first.
settings.passwordWrong: That is not your current password.
settings.signOutBody: Signing out clears the data on this device.
settings.leaveBody: If you leave without setting up an account, you cannot come back.

notif.title: Notifications
notif.noneBody: Request progress, reminders and replies from the care team appear here.
